name: 360 PDF
author: NET360

sections.description:
360 PDF lets you add PDF documents from the WordPress Media Library and display them with a responsive viewer on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

The plugin provides two display modes:

  • PDF Viewer
  • EBOOK / FLIPBOOK

The ebook mode supports single-page and double-page layouts on desktop, touch and mouse interaction, zoom controls, thumbnails, fullscreen mode, and a configurable background color.

If you would like to support the continued development of 360 PDF, you can donate to support the project.

Usage

Use the generated shortcode: [360_pdf id="123"]

Optional attributes include:
[360_pdf id=”123″ height=”800″ download=”yes” fit=”width” mode=”ebook”]

The fit attribute accepts width, page, or 100. The mode attribute accepts viewer or ebook.

Privacy

360 PDF does not send PDF documents or visitor data to an external service. The final WordPress.org distribution must package the PDF rendering library locally; no remote PDF rendering service is required.

Third-Party Libraries

360 PDF includes PDF.js 6.3.289 locally for PDF rendering. PDF.js is distributed under its applicable open-source license. Its license is included at public/assets/js/pdfjs/LICENSE.

360 PDF includes StPageFlip 2.0.7 locally for the EBOOK / FLIPBOOK page-turn effect. StPageFlip is distributed under the MIT License. Its license is included at public/assets/js/page-flip/LICENSE.

No PDF rendering library, page-turn library, JavaScript, CSS, or image asset is loaded from a third-party CDN.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the 360 PDF plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate 360 PDF from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to 360 PDF > Add PDF.
  4. Select a PDF from the Media Library.
  5. Choose the display mode and save the document.
  6. Copy the generated shortcode and place it in a post, page, widget, or compatible page builder.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial WordPress.org release preparation.
  • Added responsive PDF viewing and ebook-style page turning.
  • Added mouse and touch navigation.
  • Added thumbnails, fullscreen, zoom, page navigation, and background color controls.
